name: Teriyaki Chicken Bake with Pineapple, Bell Pepper & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small pineapple
1 green bell pepper
½ medium head cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with water, soy sauce, honey, oil, cornstarch, and spices. Whisk to combine the teriyaki marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
toasted sesame oil
2 tsp cornstarch
½ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then medium dice. Add to the bowl and stir to combine. Transfer pineapple, veggies, and chicken to a baking sheet pan, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a clean medium bowl.
When the chicken and veggies have about 10 minutes left, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower rice, water, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is golden and tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
salt
black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower rice and teriyaki chicken bake between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
